subject: general
question: Who among the following has written the biography of Buddha, Buddhacharita?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashvaghosha**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashvaghosha,** a poet and** Buddhist philosopher **from northern India in the** early second century CE**, authored the **Buddhacharita**, an epic Sanskrit poem depicting the** life of Gautama Buddha**.
 
• This significant work, categorized as a **Mahakavya, **resembles other Indian epic poems like the Ramayana and Mahabharata in style.
 
• The Buddhacharita narrates the key events in Buddha's life, drawing from authentic religious sources.
 
• Regarded as a sacred religious text, the Buddhacharita offers a meticulously structured account of Buddha's life, demonstrating restraint in its depiction of his miracles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Ashvaghosha's composition** showcases his profound understanding of Indian mythology,** pre-Buddhist philosophy,** and diverse themes such as war, love, and statecraft.
 
• Comprising 28 cantos, the Buddhacharita presents the first 14 cantos in Sanskrit, while Chinese and Tibetan translations preserve all 28 chapters.
 
• **Dharmakṣema **crafted a Chinese rendition in 420 AD, while an anonymous author produced a Tibetan adaptation in the 7th or 8th century, believed to be more faithful to the original Sanskrit text.
